harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1's dnsmasq (OpenWrt UCI dhcp.@domain) to answer app.internal -> 10.100.6.11 for the shared 10.100.6.0/24 LAN. Stood up the previously-missing HTTP service on node2 (systemd unit app8080.service running python3 http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080, firewalld port 8080/tcp opened). Pointed node3's NetworkManager DNS at node1 (10.100.6.10) so it resolves app.internal purely via DNS with no /etc/hosts entry, verified curl to http://app.internal:8080/ returns 200. Then ran the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on node1, node2, node3: captured pre-restart boot_id and service health, issued native reboot, polled until exec access returned, confirmed changed boot_id, and re-verified DNS resolution and HTTP reachability end-to-end after each restart.
actions_performed: Created /srv/app/index.html and systemd unit app8080.service on node2 running python3 -m http.server on 0.0.0.0:8080; enabled and started it
Opened firewalld port 8080/tcp permanently on node2 and reloaded
Verified baseline IP-based reachability from node3 to node2:8080 before DNS setup
Added a UCI dhcp @domain entry on node1 mapping app.internal -> 10.100.6.11 (node2), committed and restarted dnsmasq
Verified local resolution on node1 via nslookup against 10.100.6.10
Reconfigured node3's active NetworkManager connection (Wired connection 1 / enp1s0) to use 10.100.6.10 as DNS server with ipv4.ignore-auto-dns=yes, and re-activated it
Verified node3 resolves app.internal via DNS (getent hosts) and reaches http://app.internal:8080/ with HTTP 200; confirmed no /etc/hosts entry exists
Captured pre-restart boot_id and service/health baselines for node1, node2, node3
Restarted node1 via native reboot; polled until exec returned; confirmed new boot_id; verified dnsmasq running and DNS entry intact/resolving
Restarted node2 via native reboot; polled until exec returned; confirmed new boot_id; waited for network-online.target to settle; verified app8080.service became active and port 8080 listening again
Restarted node3 via native reboot; polled until exec returned; confirmed new boot_id; verified DNS config persisted, app.internal resolved, and HTTP 200 reachable with no /etc/hosts entry

evidence.requirement: node1 answers DNS for app.internal -> node2's IP on the shared network
evidence.summary: UCI dhcp @domain entry added mapping app.internal to 10.100.6.11; dnsmasq listens on 10.100.6.10:53 (LAN-reachable); nslookup confirms resolution

evidence.requirement: node2 HTTP service on 8080 exists and is reachable
evidence.summary: Found nothing listening on 8080 originally; created and started app8080.service; opened firewalld port; confirmed IP-based reachability from node3 (HTTP 200)

evidence.requirement: node3 resolves app.internal via DNS (node1) with no local hosts-file entry and reaches the service by name
evidence.summary: node3's resolv.conf points at 10.100.6.10; getent hosts app.internal resolves to 10.100.6.11; curl by name returns 200; /etc/hosts confirmed to have no app.internal entry

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 170fc672...; reboot issued and connection dropped; new boot_id fb6cc4cb... with uptime ~13s; dnsmasq running and DNS entry/resolution confirmed post-restart

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 21de1f79...; reboot issued; new boot_id dba16295... with uptime ~6s; after network-online.target settled, app8080.service became active and port 8080 listening; node3 confirmed HTTP 200 by name post-restart

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline, restart, changed boot identity, recovery
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8f258838...; reboot issued; new boot_id f43fd027... with uptime ~6s; DNS config persisted, app.internal resolved via getent, HTTP 200 by name, no /etc/hosts entry
